purpose: Sound section: different relaxed youthful adult woman with olive skin, high skin detail and smaller earbuds
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / photorealistic-natural
Edit the supplied wide transparent portrait into a new version. Two changes are essential: a CLEARLY DIFFERENT WOMAN, and SIGNIFICANTLY SMALLER EARBUDS. Preserve the blue-violet-pink sound waves, black/transparent setting and wide format.

1. Replace the woman entirely with a different adult woman, around 25–28 years old, youthful and athletic, with a warm OLIVE complexion. She has a visibly different facial identity from the current portrait: a slightly rounder youthful face, naturally strong dark eyebrows, soft cheek contours, a softly defined athletic jaw, a different nose and mouth, and deep dark-brown hair casually pulled into a loose low bun with a few natural wisps. Believable ordinary athletic woman, naturally attractive, not a retouched glamour model. Show upper chest and softly defined shoulders in a simple black athletic crew-neck top. Keep her facing straight ahead, CHIN LEVEL, both eyes gently CLOSED. Expression much more relaxed: smooth unstrained brow, relaxed cheeks and jaw, a tiny contented closed-mouth smile, shoulders down and at ease. No upward head tilt, no ecstatic expression. No jewelry or visible logos.
Skin remains extremely detailed and photographic: visible natural pores, fine facial hairs, tiny freckles and slight skin-tone variations, authentic lip and eyelid texture, individual lashes and brow hairs. Healthy olive undertone, realistic diffuse daylight on the face. Keep fine skin microtexture in sharp focus. No airbrushing, waxy smoothing, oily plastic shine or artificial uniform grain. Youthful doesn't mean textureless.

2. Reduce EACH floating earbud to ABOUT HALF its current height and width. This reduction must be obvious. Each complete earbud including its wing should now be no more than HALF the visible height of her outer ear. Keep the same accurate earbud design from image 2: compact smoke-translucent dark housing, matte black circular faceplate and narrow champagne rim, plain curved black wing, smoky silicone tip, tiny champagne contact accents and fine black braided cable. No large sunburst metal disc, no gold pad on the outer upper wing. Normal very small life-size audio accessories, not oversized product hero objects. Float one to each side at her ear height, tips aimed inward. Cables remain fine and hang downward naturally. Image 2 is the definitive product design reference only, not a size reference.

3. Preserve the larger flowing colourful sound-wave strands between each inward-facing earbud tip and its corresponding ear. Smooth cyan/blue to violet and pink gradient along three or four elegant curves. Adjust their endpoints to meet the smaller buds and new ear positions. Keep them in the gaps beside her face, with empty transparent space between strands, no bright starbursts or fog and no effects over her skin.

Composition invariants: centered front-facing head-and-shoulders portrait, head upright and fully in frame, woman approximately same overall scale, wide 2.4:1 horizontal canvas. Both earbuds and the full woman fit safely within central 55% of canvas. Large transparent margins left and right. GENUINE TRANSPARENT alpha background everywhere outside the subject, buds and waves. NO light halo, NO gray background behind her head, NO solid background or checkerboard. Opaque human and earbuds with natural fine hair edges, selectively translucent coloured waves. Black clothing gently disappears into transparency along bottom. High resolution and high skin fidelity. No text or watermark.
